reviewMethod: MANUAL CHATGPT FOUR-PASS REVIEW // R1 EXTRACTION // R2 1.0-TO-2.0 DELTA // R3 MEAT/GRAHAM INTERPRETATION // R4 AUDIT
role: POST-PRESEASON REVISION OVERLAY // REFERENCE CONTEXT // NOT A BETTING DECISION ENGINE
decisionBoundary: VSiN 2.0 updates the VSiN source layer. It may inform Meat Desk and governed Graham/Walters revalidation, but it cannot directly create a BET, supply executable prices, or silently move Graham/Walters FAIR.

lineage.policy: Preserve 1.0 as baseline/history. Apply 2.0 field by field. Silence in 2.0 does not confirm or supersede 1.0. Never silently blend contradictory opinions.

classificationPolicy.fieldLevelRule: SUPERSEDED applies to the specific fact or premise that changed, not automatically to the entire team or every prior wager derived from it.
classificationPolicy.silenceRule: A 1.0 item not revisited in 2.0 remains BASELINE, not CONFIRMED.
classificationPolicy.priceRule: Guide prices are historical snapshots until current market revalidation.

rounds.purpose: Complete extraction of 2.0: expert best bets, Week 1 systems, power ratings, 32 team updates, Survivor/contest material and freshness notes.
Cross-reference 1.0 vs 2.0 team by team and subject by subject; classify deltas and preserve author-level opinion history.
Interpret what belongs in Meat Desk and Graham/Walters while preserving source boundaries and prohibiting automatic betting weight.
Audit classifications, conflicts, stale-number handling, field-level supersession and internal source inconsistencies.

sourceSections.treatment: ATTRIBUTED OPINION // PRESERVE AUTHOR + MARKET + SOURCE NUMBER
CONTEST INTELLIGENCE // OUTSIDE ORDINARY MEAT WEIGHTING
CONDITIONAL HISTORICAL SYSTEM FLAGS // REVALIDATE CURRENT LINE
CONFIRMED NUMERIC REFERENCE // DO NOT AVERAGE INTO GRAHAM FAIR

freshness.rule: Store supplied as-of date per item where available. Do not stamp every extracted fact with the review date.

powerRatings.finding: All 32 Steve Makinen power ratings in 2.0 match the original 1.0 table exactly.
powerRatings.grahamTreatment: The original VSiN/Makinen numbers remain Graham's immutable origin seed. 2.0 confirms the seed; it does not rebase current carried-forward Graham ratings.

teamDeltas.summary: DJ Moore camp outlook improved versus the original concern; defensive transition concern remains. New Ty Johnson/CJ Gardner-Johnson health and Javon Solomon information.
Poor overall outlook remains, but Malik Willis' camp evaluation improved materially; Malik Washington emerges as an important receiving piece.
Maye/A.J. Brown core remains intact; new Will Campbell development, Kayshon Boutte trade, Christian Gonzalez situation and Kyle Williams information.
Geno/overall pessimism remains. Kenyon Sadiq's expected readiness from 1.0 is no longer safe after the hernia issue derailed camp; new David Bailey, Breece Hall and OL information.
Danny Pinter's role as part of the center solution is obsolete after a season-ending patellar injury; Ja'Kobi Lane becomes a new camp development.
Elite-offense/below-average-defense premise remains; Ja'Marr Chase knee scare, DJ Turner/Cashius Howell progress and Dohnte Meyers are new.
Quarterback competition is resolved to Deshaun Watson as Week 1 starter; overall offensive pessimism is reinforced.
Rodgers/McCarthy thesis remains, but offensive-line concern grows and Broderick Jones is gone; Drew Allar becomes noteworthy.
Stroud/OL questions and elite-defense thesis remain; Jayden Higgins ACL loss and Kayshon Boutte acquisition materially change receiver context.
Existing Daniel Jones baseline survives; Riley Leonard wins QB2, Keenan Allen arrives amid receiver injuries, with new Ward/Walley health information.
Travis Hunter's defensive-back conversion was already present in 1.0; 2.0 clarifies him as a starting corner who will occasionally play receiver and describes him as a defensive player first.
Cam Ward/Saleh/Daboll optimism survives, but OL performance adds downside; Elic Ayomanor becomes a significant new receiving development.
Bo Nix recovery uncertainty from 1.0 is replaced by a healthy/sharp post-preseason status; elite-defense thesis remains.
Mahomes availability/mobility uncertainty is replaced by full-practice health; new pre-snap offensive work, Kenneth Walker III, Peter Woods, Cyrus Allen and Rashee Rice context.
Cousins-as-bridge/Mendoza-development plan survives preseason; Ashton Jeanty injury and Hezekiah Masses are new.
Tyler Biadasz changed from a projected OL upgrade in 1.0 to season-ending ACL/IR; rookie Jake Slaughter takes over at center.
Tyler Guyton LT uncertainty improves; Christian Parker's defense generated encouraging camp evidence; Von Miller and Javonte Williams add context.
John Harbaugh culture thesis is reinforced and defense looked encouraging, while new concern appears over offensive messaging for Jaxson Dart.
1.0 optimism about Sean Mannion's offense is downgraded by inconsistent camp reports; defensive strength remains.
Daniels/coordinator rebound thesis remains and WR situation improves, but Laremy Tunsil and Jer'Zhan Newton are lost for the season.
1.0 turnover-regression concern survives; new LT and secondary health issues add risk.
Existing OL/health concerns worsen; Cade Mays unavailable initially plus secondary and skill-position injuries.
Micah Parsons timeline worsens to torn ACL/out until at least mid-October; Josh Jacobs uncertainty advances to commissioner-exempt status.
Kyler Murray/O'Connell reclamation thesis remains; new secondary injuries and Jordan Mason workload information deepen the profile.
QB uncertainty remains unresolved; Penix limited and Tua did not seize job; Jalon Walker ACL loss is a new negative.
1.0 bearish/Under thesis is reinforced by poor camp, multiple OL injuries and defensive losses.
1.0 turnaround thesis remains, but Jordyn Tyson injury, Alvin Kamara absence and Rashid Shaheed departure weaken the offensive setup.
Bucky Irving/offensive premise remains; Tampa had one of the cleaner camps; Vita Vea/Bain health developments are new.
Weak-QB/team context remains; Jeremiyah Love high-ankle sprain and Chase Bisontis season-ending MCL injury are new negatives.
Aaron Donald moved from possible comeback in 1.0 to an actual return in 2.0; Myles Garrett/Puka Nacua/Alaric Jackson health or availability issues add counterweights.
The 1.0 healthier-roster premise is invalidated by widespread injuries and Ricky Pearsall season-ending knee surgery.
Darnold/Price/JSN framework survives; Charbonnet and defensive-back injuries increase uncertainty and potentially increase Jadarian Price's role.

week1Systems.rule: Week 1 non-conference home teams priced +3 to -3
Road teams that won 4-6 games prior season
Opening-week home favorites hosting prior-year >.500 teams
Divisional road/neutral dogs of 6.5 or less
week1Systems.caveat: Guide notes recent results may indicate the angle is losing its luster.

week1Systems.rule: Non-conference road favorites of 6 or less
Fade prior-year teams that scored >26 PPG when not facing another high-scoring team
Prior-year teams that allowed <20 PPG when not facing another strong defense
Prior-year turnover differential of -0.9/game or worse rebound
Teams with 8+ close losses of 8 points or fewer
Teams that dropped at least five wins prior season
week1Systems.caveat: Side/rebound evidence and Under-total evidence are separate market signals and must not be collapsed.

conflictingExamples.detail: System 8 is play-against while System 9 is play-on.
System 8 is play-against while System 12 supplies rebound/Under evidence.
Tyler Shoemaker likes Tennessee -2.5 while System 10 is a Jets play-on angle.

week1SystemInterpretation.rule: Treat multiple qualifying systems as a cluster, not independent votes. Preserve the underlying rule, sample and market. For line-sensitive systems, current Betting Edge line determines ACTIVE vs OUT_OF_RANGE.

expertConflicts.treatment: Display as VSIN EXPERT CONFLICT; never manufacture consensus.
Directional disagreement with a middle; not mathematically exclusive.
Different views/range; exactly 10 wins can satisfy both.

meatIntegration.sourceCountRule: VSiN 2.0 is a revision overlay of the existing VSiN NFL source slot, not an additional independent Meat Desk source.
doNotWeight: historical guide prices as live prices
Survivor/Circa strategy in ordinary side-total decisions
expert consensus as automatic model points
meatIntegration.convergenceRule: Convergence may be displayed when independent VSiN evidence types align, but it is an attention marker, not a BET.

grahamIntegration.seedPolicy: Keep original VSiN/Makinen power ratings as immutable origin seed because 2.0 republishes the same 32 values.
grahamIntegration.currentRatingPolicy: Never reset carried-forward Graham currentRating to the VSiN seed.
grahamIntegration.personnelPolicy: 2.0 personnel may challenge, confirm or trigger review of a Graham assumption. It may change a carried rating only through the existing governed delta process with explicit evidence and numeric adjustment.
grahamIntegration.fairPolicy: VSiN expert opinions and Makinen Week 1 systems do not enter BW FAIR automatically and may not silently move it.
grahamIntegration.marketPolicy: Independent Graham/Walters fair build remains before market comparison.

sourceConflict.detail: Page 17 says three Christmas games and five teams playing both holidays; later pages say four Christmas games and six double-holiday teams, with page 22 naming GB, LAR, CHI, BUF, PHI and DEN.
sourceConflict.treatment: Preserve as source inconsistency; do not silently correct in source record.

auditConclusions: 2.0 silence does not confirm an old 1.0 item.
All 32 raw Makinen power ratings are confirmed unchanged; 1.0 projected wins, HFA and schedule-strength figures are not thereby confirmed.
Expert bets remain attributed to their authors and source numbers.
Week 1 system qualifiers must preserve rule/sample/market and revalidate current line where required.
Survivor and contest material remain outside ordinary Meat Desk weighting.
Guide futures/prop/spread prices remain historical until current market verification.
